claim: Test one-sided objective repair on unused historical source groups; not agent-task, split, meta-network, AGI or net-cost benefit evidence
required_before_freeze: Independent review of new explicit nonlinear runner, target identity and complete-state/cost recording
Pin actual new source and exclusion manifests, prepared without model outputs
Freeze code commit, environment, new dataset hashes, all conditions and resource caps before any new Encoder run
Fail preparation if any predeclared count is unavailable; retain failure, no silent source/window fallback
Preserve the original published objective and opened May/June outcomes unchanged

source_proposal.dataset: UCI News Aggregator historical four-class headlines, one task family
source_proposal.grouping: Global story-ID/normalized-title union components before splitting; exclude cross-month and conflicting-label components
source_proposal.exclude: Every component touching every role of all prior news cohorts including PFT; inventory all additional prepared/active cohorts before freeze
source_proposal.selection: One row per component, class-balanced fixed SHA256 ordering with salt cell-retention-v1-20261024; no outcome-dependent selection
source_proposal.pretraining_exposure: unknown; not prospective or unseen-task-family evidence

common_model.features: one shared exact encoding; no per-arm extraction; frozen label-independent QR384-to-8 seed20261024
common_model.optimizer: same frozen full-batch Adam protocol as PFT; preserve all moments/step/context
common_model.observation: same full theta/m/v reference-relative state for both control arms
common_model.geometry: same frozen A/E/C per seed/head; no extra information given only to hinge

new_objective.anchor: old-probe NLL at original warmup endpoint; immutable across all suffix solves
new_objective.tolerance_basis: prospective fixed tolerance, not selected from published May/June results

resource_caps.accounting: Measure warmup/reference shared work, all policy/suffix solves, rejected/nonfinite trials, online state/probe work, final evaluation, state/checkpoint bytes and reload; do not double-count overlapping wall spans

primary.comparison: hinge minus legacy, separately for each predeclared head; no best-head selection
primary.metric: equal-weight July/August mean NLL after all trajectories and predictions are sealed
primary.uncertainty: paired source-component bootstrap conditional on all three fixed fits; 2000 replicates seed820241; report each month and every seed
primary.retention_gate: old-test NLL difference one-sided upper97.5 percentile bound <= 0.02 nats
primary.future_gate: future NLL difference one-sided upper97.5 percentile bound < 0; otherwise inconclusive or negative
primary.multiplicity: Two predeclared heads: nominal Bonferroni alpha=0.025 per head; within each head require both future and retention gates (intersection-union). Bootstrap coverage remains an approximation conditional on source sampling and fixed fits.
primary.cost_gate: both cap compliance and measured incremental cost must be reported; this protocol alone does not certify net-cost benefit

secondary: old-probe violation integral and terminal value
unilateral and original quadratic objectives reported separately
full process tree CPU/RSS and cold/warm load separation
failures: All unavailable sources, rejected identities, numerical/cap failures and lost observations retained; no omission, retry-to-positive or substitution
